name: Chinese Academy of Sciences’ Shanghai Institute of Microsystem and Information Technology
zh: 中国科学院上海微系统与信息技术研究所
aliases: Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai Institute of Microsystem and Information Technology
Shanghai Institute of Microsystem and Information Technology

evidence.summary: CASI lists the microsystem technology laboratory (微系统技术国防科技重点实验室), set up at SIMIT in 2004, among China’s national defence science and technology key laboratories, while calling its status ambiguous: SIMIT itself called it a defence key laboratory when it was being established, and the laboratory’s research fund used that name in 2023. Its research includes target detection, identification and tracking, and UAV communications.
items: Microsystem Technology Defense S&T Key Laboratory (微系统技术国防科技重点实验室)

evidence.summary: SIMIT is an institute of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, founded in 1928; CASI notes that it was historically involved in developing key uranium-enrichment components for China’s nuclear programme.

sources.title: China’s Defense S&T Key Lab System: 2025 Update (October 2025), pp. 311–312 (Defense S&T Key Laboratory of Microsystem Technology)
